📱 QR code generator guide

With Sorola's QR generator you can create versatile QR codes for free. Share websites, contact details, WiFi passwords, and more with a single scan.

1. Choose the QR code type

Choose the type you want from the dropdown based on what information you want to share:

  • Website (URL): Shares a web address that opens in the browser after scanning.
  • Free text: Includes any text in the QR code.
  • WiFi network: Lets the recipient join your network automatically without typing the password.
  • Email: Opens a new message with the recipient address and subject pre-filled.
  • Call number: Opens a phone call to the given number.
  • Send text message: Opens the messaging app with the number and message pre-filled.

2. Enter the details

Fill in the fields related to the type you selected. For example:

  • For URL type: https://sorola.fi/en/
  • For WiFi type: network name (SSID), password and security type (usually WPA/WPA2).

You can also choose a color for the code with the color picker.

3. Update and download the QR code

  1. Press Copy to clipboard to use the result. Update QR code button, and the finished code will appear on screen.
  2. Check the code by scanning it with your phone.
  3. Press Copy to clipboard to use the result. Download as an image (PNG), jos haluat tallentaa koodin laitteellesi.

Privacy

QR codes are generated via a server-side API endpoint, but the data you enter is not stored on the server. Do not enter passwords or other sensitive data into the QR generator.
